Ingress.source_within.detail: Three occupied peer/control positions with continued refill: the initial third frame is selected within three network polls. Nonempty synthetic infinite selector execution; both local and peer offers continue forever. Premises apply to the exact production selector functions, interpreted with explicit queues. Bounds count completed chooser turns; this does not prove native IO/queue refinement, bounded memory for the growing witness or end-to-end display latency.

Prioritized.source_within.detail: The nested UI-first selector begins with two local writes and three occupied mailboxes; the target in slot1 is selected at turn7, within12turns. Nonempty synthetic infinite selector execution; both local and peer offers continue forever. Premises apply to the exact production selector functions, interpreted with explicit queues. Bounds count completed chooser turns; this does not prove native IO/queue refinement, bounded memory for the growing witness or end-to-end display latency.
